subject: In-session subagent tokens (auto-fix --prepare path) reach the ticket's cost[] and cost_total
objective: For a worker / verifier subagent dispatched via 'auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker|verifier', its token usage (the SubagentStop agent.cost event) becomes one cost[] row on ticket <n> when the ticket closes and is counted in cost_total; subagents whose ticket is only guessed stay out, as today.
acceptance: A1 scripts/agent-cost-hook.py, SubagentStop: when the subagent transcript's first user prompt contains an auto-fix --prepare dispatch path '<anything>/t<N>/<run_id>/dispatch-round<R>.md' (worker) or '.../dispatch-verifier-round<R>.md' (verifier), the agent.cost event carries ticket '<N>', role 'worker' / 'verifier', round R (int), run_id '<run_id>' taken from that path - even when the Agent description names another #n.

A2 A SubagentStop prompt without such a path, and every SessionEnd, produce the same event as on base (ticket guessed, round / run_id null): the existing tests/test_agent_cost_hook.py cases stay green with their assertions unchanged.

A3 'ticket.py close <n>' (also 'close --landed' and 'set <n> state Done', i.e. every path that writes cost_total) appends, in the same save, one cost[] row per (session_id, agent_id) for the LAST agent.cost event of that pair among events with ticket == n and a non-null run_id; the row has exactly the 15 cost keys (role/round/run_id/session_id/model/token fields/wall_seconds from the event, outcome null, by 'agent-cost-hook', note containing the agent_id), and cost_total counts it (by_role.worker.tokens_in = headless rows + folded row, hand-computed in the test).

A4 agent.cost events with run_id null (guessed ticket), events of other tickets, and role=main events are not folded: A5CostTotalIgnoresAgentCost in tests/test_agent_cost_hook.py stays green unchanged.
A5 A cost[] row already present for the same (run_id, agent_id) is not appended again (folding twice leaves one row).

A6 Tie to the real prompt: the stdout pointer of 'auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker' and '--prepare verifier' (the fixtures in tests/test_auto_fix.py ThePrepareWorkerStopsBeforeTheProcess / ThePrepareVerifierCopy) fed to the hook's prompt parser yields ticket n, the right role, round 1 and the run dir name as run_id.

A7 Docs follow: tickets/SCHEMA.md rows 'cost' / '互動成本' / 'cost_total' state which agent.cost events are folded at close and that guessed ones still are not; the agent-cost-hook.py / transcript-cost.py docstrings no longer claim round / run_id are always null or that agent.cost never reaches cost[]. scripts/sync-to-project.sh is NOT part of this ticket (it is in board/config.json hard_block.paths, so no worker commit can touch it; objection 1 triaged accepted): its '不進票 cost[]' line is a main-line, human-authorised follow-up listed in the outline.

Cases go into existing modules (D-056: no new ticket-numbered case files): tests/test_agent_cost_hook.py, tests/test_ticket.py (CostTotalOnClose neighbourhood), tests/test_auto_fix.py (prepare classes). verify.tags stays empty (cases live in tests/; no feature tag). T4 (A4) Same root plus events: (s, a3, run_id null, ticket '7'), (s, a4, run R3, ticket '8'), (role main, agent_id null, ticket '7'). Expect none folded (row count as in T3).
T5 (A5) Pre-seed cost[] with a row for (R1, a1); close -> still one row for that pair.
T6 (A6) Reuse the prepare fixtures: capture stdout of '--prepare worker' / '--prepare verifier', pass it to the parser function the hook uses (transcript-cost.py), assert ticket / role / round / run_id equal the run dir that the fixture created (read from the filesystem, not from the parser).

Mutations (not measured by the opener): M1 fold every agent.cost event instead of the last per (session_id, agent_id) -> T3 red (tokens 35). M2 drop the run_id-not-null filter -> T4 red. M3 hook keeps run_id null for prepare prompts -> T1 red.
Full suite: the ticket gate's table for the touched files; land runs the full suite anyway.
outline: D-063 (3): --prepare worker/verifier subagent tokens reach the ticket's cost[]. Measured: the SubagentStop hook already writes agent.cost per subagent (board/events.jsonl: #149 opener/verifier/worker, #147 worker/verifier) with a guessed ticket, round/run_id null, tokens_out null (interactive stream). The #147 prepare prompt contains reports/t147/20261021-095546-17288/dispatch-round1.md, so ticket/run/round/role are exact for this path; hand-dispatched subagents (the #147 objection verifier) have no path and stay guessed. A resumed subagent writes a second cumulative event (a6d0d4f8: 259s then 1624s), so fold the LAST event per (session_id, agent_id), once, in ticket.py close (the save that writes cost_total; events exist by then). Files: scripts/agent-cost-hook.py, scripts/transcript-cost.py, scripts/ticket.py, tickets/SCHEMA.md, tests. Does not touch auto-fix.sh. needs_verifier=true: new contract (hook marks + close fold). simple. Not here: hand-dispatched subagents, opener cost, wall_seconds includes idle time of resumed agents. Objection 1 (round 1, accepted): sync-to-project.sh dropped from A7/T7 (hard_block.paths). Main-line TODO, needs human authorisation: sync-to-project.sh line 466 '(不進票 cost[])' should add the --prepare exception after #152 lands. Worker head 6bccba0 already meets the revised A7/T7 (SCHEMA + both docstrings changed, sync untouched): no rework; verifier drops any sync-to-project.sh assertion.
